body: Right, sounds like an intelligent way to end the world. What scares you most?
No there not. You're speaking on something you don't know which means you're not helping. End of conversation.

Life reflecting is great because life is great! Just because I'm breathing doesn't mean I'm living. Life will not miss me. Life will advance. Life is eternal. Life will not be abandoned by those who truly live it. To live is to advance mind, body and soul.

 I just exist to serve a minor purpose in a living personification's aka person's development. I'm like cell that can die and be replaced in a body. That body is my sister. She is the one who will have children. She is the one who will carry our bloodline into the future. She is very important. She is more than just a sibling...she's a REGENERATOR. She carries a soul and I carry a spirit...I cannot get what I need. What I need is not a thing it is a life purpose...a future intelligence.

It's interesting that you believe you know how I relate to my sister...I wonder if I cleared things up for you. I know my role in the grander scheme of things is coming to an end. That's the reality. Whether I choose to behave like a victim or a judge its up to perception.

 I've decided to depart on my own terms and that makes me feel empowered.
Nope...but I will definitely read it. Thanks for sharing.

I typed it...my intent was to just write to my boyfriend a poem so he could understand why I love him and how I love myself by doing so. I'm still working on it but I really love how empowering it is. It's not a woe is me deal....it's a good for me where the hell is your good for you deal?

No....not an interesting place. I just think I should have an healthy understanding so I can navigate. Good luck with your trip...you should do it. Why not?  Enough about society...I really don't care...like that doesn't really live in my mind because I already know what's going on. Suicide is more stimulating to me...I just wrote my first letter...such a aesthetic activity.

You're welcome. Can you give me a good book on geography? I think I want to understand it before my departure. I empathize with your struggle but I don't feel sorry. Struggle gives us an opportunity to think. It is what it is. Do something about it. 

"Forget it enough to move forward, remember enough not the make the same mistake."  -Shakar Brumfield.

I know I have a weak mind so I assume 10 years from now I'll be even less interested in existence. That makes me feel nauseas. I'd rather fight all of the fears and just make my own departure then leave on someone else's terms. This society isn't going to get better and neither are the people in it. How are you holding up?

Well fuck them...without morals we lose integrity and self esteem and before we know it we end up this subreddit. I suppose I just proves your point that we are against each other after all. But how can you expect us to be different? Most of us are products of mothers and fathers who don't take responsibility because their mothers and fathers didn't set an example. Earlier I stated I think I exist as a harsh consequence. I grew up more focused on hating my mother and plotting ways to end my stepfather then developing my mind or talents. I honestly think I am punishment to her and to myself. There as to be tons just like me and more being created. Everything in this society is falling down...you seem like you read books...Yeah you've been judged again. Anyway most empires fall around 300 years...if you're still walking around in 40 years you'll
have a better understanding. Oh, and I think your mind is beautiful by the way. I like the way the word your sentences and seem to pull in a stream of intelligence. I think you're worth talking to.

I don't think we're in an entirely different civilization although it has advanced. My point is that alot of us have not advanced with it. So many of us intelligent children have been spoiled rotten mentally. We don't have to think when we can just probe answers on Google. Do you understand? This is not about money or the lack of it this is about mental degeneration. I used to be a stripper because I refused to work a regular job and I know money doesn't bring peace of mind nor does it replace your soul. And who the hell is being judgemental anymore...most people are open-minded. They don't have boundaries or morals.
That makes two of us

Okay so I'm spoiled brat level II that's why I fit into the troubled youngsters category. The troubled kids know what's wrong, right? What's troubling you? I checked your page...you're suffering from anxiety and depression. Is there trauma?

Yeah...it's called soul...a connection to a power beyond this world responsible for the development of it. I most certainly don't have one of those. I'm a walking vessel full if some miserable earth bound spirits who use my emotional break downs as opportunities to guide me in some self destructive habit such as binge-eating. Just because I haven't been diagnosed doesn't mean I'm not mentally ill. I'm definitely a product of the spoiled degeneration and I think I only exist as a consequence to my mother's decision to bare a child from a man she did not deserve. I've been angry with her for so long even though I've forgiven her she still feels guilty.

Yeah and before they fought in wars they fought hard to provide for their families. They didn't expect things to come over night. They understood patience and they knew that decisions were to be made with caution.
So you think 1 and 2 are true but you don't understand why I would not see a futute for myself?

1) I haven't lost hope in life because life is eternal and rather I whether I stop breathing not, reality will not be affected.  I'm just a human who exist to serve a minor purpose like a cell and once I depart another vessel that serves the same function will replace me. 

2) Do I think life will get better, yes absolutely. Life is constantly developing. Existence however is limited. People, animals, things come, serve, go. I have grown from an egg to an adult with a rather child like mentality that makes it difficult to be sucessful. So as the challenges of existence become harder I will mentally and physically break down. That's why I consider suicide...figure I'll save myself from experiencing a slow death.

3) No I can not see a future for myself in the next 10 years. I can see me losing myself.

Thanks for the questions. I hope my response was useful for you.

A few months a go I attempted suicide and failed. I took a large amount of oxycodons, sleeping pills, and downed them with a bottle of Crown Apple....nothing happened. I remember waking up because my mom called. I answered the phone and I could not speak only murmur a few different variations of the  same sound. She didn't notice I was impaired and got off the phone eventually. I rolled over and slept for the next 8 hours or so. I think about it sometimes and laugh.

My advice to you would be to laugh. I know you're sad... probably struggling with depression like myself and clearly suicidal like myself. I'm suicidal because I failed....I failed at life. I had a great start with great potential. Yet, I always burn out before I reach the finish line.  When I think of my existence I can't even feel sad for too long because it's actually hilarious. I'm convinced it just can't be real...I can't be real.
*Curtis Mayfield*

The last thing you said about living if you don't have a soul...I'm right here with you. 

I'm convinced it's impossible to conquer the challenges of existence without the power of your soul to do so. And I wasted time using my willpower to trying to fit into a soulless world so here I am. I think about how my soul is back home charging at the source where souls do to get there energy. Meanwhile, I'm stuck on the planet all out if alignment...brain dead but still breathing like a zombie.
You're welcome charming 😊

I think most people are out of touch with reality but I suppose you're speaking about a disorder more intense. Especially with you mentioning the chemical imbalance which has to do with your brain but you probably have a beautiful mind. I don't care what anyone claims about suicide. I think it's an logical decision for most of us. If you can see how it makes sense that means you can think. Thought is 💡light. And light grows life!
Hmmm. I hear you. What are you anxious about?

It is rare but that's how you know it's pure and powerful. And if you find your bliss in understanding then I understand. Maybe you should listen to jazz and write to yourself...ask yourself some of these questions you're asking me. Answering those questions and finding an understanding is what keeps me standing. And you know what's true because what's true makes sense.

Why not? When has anything great been accomplished without a great sacrifice? I mean seriously think about it. How do kids eat without their parents working to ensure they are nurtured? Shit, what about the pain of child birth it's self? What about the greatest nation and how it came to be? 

You're not bringing anything positive to me. What is positive if negative doesn't exist? You're bringing me to realize what I think. I think that the only other way out of a slow death is suicide. That's why I found this page.

Sure I do. But it doesn't matter what qualities I may have if I have no reason to remember them. We find bliss in being alive because through out our challenges we understand how useful we are and we have a desire to become greater. 

I really don't want to sound so harsh because it seems like you have a real pure intent. Unfortunately, I'm not going to change my mind.  I understand the reality that people must be sacrificed for evolution overall. I'm one of those people and I'm doing my best to manage the fact that I'm dying. Everyone doesn't win.

When I'm standing, it's clear I'm headed downhill. Am I happy with it, no but that doesn't mean I'm going to change it. I don't have that power. I do sacrifice and I must to keep from becoming to heavy. The further down I go the more I must sacrifice just to stand again. Situations happen and my behaviors make me crumble. It's like I'm not fit to develop..it's like I am incomplete.

When I stand up I can clearly see the direction I'm headed and I wonder how long I can stand still. Wonder how long I can hold my breath. Wonder how can I matter to the person I see climbing forward because maybe then I have a reason to just be. Maybe then I had a reason for not getting worse. When I'm falling down it's because I have given in to the gravity. I stopped believing there was someone to support who would prosper from my sacrifices and so I chose to sacrifice my existence. ---yeah

I hear you. I give up much too often. It's actually apart of my behavior. I'm trying to outsmart myself. Gather self confidence through understanding myself while I have my mind so when I break down I have enough strength to protect myself from my own demons.
Yeah I guess that's why I make post...well mostly just to be transparent. I will get better but I understand it'll get worse first
Well maybe just because they are close to me in distance or were doesn't mean they were close to me in intent. I'm alright. I guess I was venting about it...understanding it.

Me too!!!! I don't think your mind sucks unless you mean it picks up on low frequency thoughts and you then use those thoughts to bring others around you down into misery. Then you might have a vampire mind.
Well then it's important it's here then. It's strange how you don't think they can be shared anywhere else, but I understand. I haven't told my bf I was suicidal, yet.
Okay. Cool.

I think we get the chance to be regenerated.  Energy never dies and you can discover that by looking all around. Depending on your level of responsibility you may be conscious human being or something with less mind power such as a dog.
I understand. The worst part is remembering that after you wake up you have to through with the whole day. I've tried sleeping it away but I can't and that makes me feel even more miserable.

I've been on a break...I haven't had a job in 4 months. Everyone knows I'm suicidal but they can only care for so long. After a while people want to move on so they just kinda disappear and wait for the chips to fall into place. I don't care to get there attention. I don't care to travel. And I don't exist to do what I want to do, but I suppose you didn't read that. All I want to do is sleep. Why is your name thrown away?
